```text
# #3439: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 42488997384](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42488997384) on `staging` (`b01bbd5`, workflow_dispatch) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [e2e component (chrome)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42488997384/job/128758328783) | cancelled |
| [e2e (8/8)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42488997384/job/128759442245) | failure |
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42488997384/job/128759442359) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: this run is on `staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix. The fix lands on `main` like any other, and promote-staging.yml brings it to `staging` within two hours; the next daily run there that passes promotes it, or a `/promote` on the production issue tests staging's newer commit sooner. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```

## Found so far
- No access to the job logs (no GitHub from here). Reproducing locally.
- Failed jobs: e2e (8/8) = specs 09,13,18,24,34,38,45,99 (shard-specs.mjs 8 8); fuzz (3/4) = seeds 5001..7500 plain,
  same handicap, Duos 1001..1500; e2e component (chrome) cancelled (probably its 20 min timeout-minutes).
- release jackioh built at /home/runner/work/JackiOh/JackiOh/target/release/jackioh (CARGO_TARGET_DIR is shared).
- Running fuzz shard 3 into /tmp/fz-plain.log /tmp/fz-hand.log /tmp/fz-duos.log (prints only at end).
- No node_modules at start; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` started into /tmp/pnpm-install.log.
- Recent commits since last daily fix (#3409 03e0cbaf9d): 310f441206 (#3369 mythic full art), e9b9946ddc (#3372 anomaly),
  6ea0b88fd1 (#3380 sentence case: changed e2e specs 19,20,33,34,48), 1fbbecc15e, add37b58df, b01bbd555c, 7336cf5731.
- Component specs run only in the daily run; several big new ones (starship-moments, anomaly-moments, fx-signature*, classicplus-*).

## FINDINGS (fuzz shard 3, reproduced locally at HEAD 7336cf5)
- plain 5001..7500: 2500 pass. Duos 1001..1500: 2 "checkpoint ... past CHECKPOINT_TIME_BOUND_MS" (wall-clock, only under my load; retry in isolation).
- HANDICAP 5001..7500: seed 6091 PANICS deterministically: `the resolution loop did not settle in 24000 passes (§10.3)`
  at crates/engine/src/triggers.rs:1544, "hard p2, turn -1, -1 actions" (setup?). Repro: `jackioh fuzz --from 6091 --seeds 1 --handicap` (20 s).
  Seeds 6580, 7113, 7264 handicap: checkpoint 6-7 s past bound (wall-clock; loaded machine) - recheck in isolation.
- e2e: pnpm install done (node_modules present now), cypress 16.1.0 installed, wasm built (apps/web/src/wasm/pkg), server release build in /tmp/server-build.log.

## ROOT CAUSE of fuzz 3/4 (found with a scratch copy in /tmp/scratch, debug prints; not in worktree)
Seed 6091 --handicap: action 115 (p1's Attack c136 core-t-sheep -> hero-p2) loops forever:
 P1 holds Warp Disruptor II (stinkyscape-024, c125, backrow): "After your opponent summons a Unit, each of your Units attacks it" (forced_attacks, no `random`).
 P2 holds c94 = fused trap `t-16:stinkyscape-109+(t-14:craft:#f13b...+(t-12:#bad2...))` standing in Units lane 4 (TrapFired again:Some(true)):
 when a P2 sheep (core-t-sheep) is destroyed it fires and Summons a new core-t-sheep (lane 3). Each summon re-triggers c125's forced attack by P1's c136 (4 atk)
 which destroys the sheep, which fires c94 again ... 6 events per settle pass, 24000 passes -> panic (triggers.rs:1544 settle).
- Exact loop (decoded): c94 = fused ANIMATED trap (Brittle 2) sitting in Units lane 4 carrying crafted text "Reveals when your opponent attacks: Summon a Sheep Token" (hat OpponentAttacks -> SummonSheep).
  Disruptor II's forced attack (AttackDeclared forced:true) is "opponent attacks" -> c94 fires (re-arms, Animated) -> Summoned sheep -> Disruptor trigger queued -> forced attack ... never ends.
  Each pass is a separate queued trigger (NOT nested); events per pass: Destroyed, TrapFired(again), Summoned, HookResolving(c125), AttackDeclared(forced), Damage.
- Precedents for fixes: R2197005 (Floodgates terminator), R1881007 (Pocket Peptides guard); chain caps in crates/engine/src/config.rs: CALL_TO_CHAOS_CHAIN_CAP, SPELL_ANSWER_CHAIN_CAP, RANDOM_CAST_CHAIN_CAP (20)

## TRUE ROOT CAUSE of fuzz 3/4 (seed 6091 handicap): crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs `reveal_trigger` (~line 861-890)
 `with_when` for CraftHatKind::OpponentAttacks matches GameEvent::AttackDeclared without checking `forced`. R121: "a forced attack is declared by the effect, not the player ...
 a trap or trigger keyed to an opponent's declaration does not arm on one". Every printed trap does `if *forced { return false }` (TG c013 explosive_runes, core c096 my_pawn, meditative c064).
 FIX: in reveal_trigger's `with_when`, `GameEvent::AttackDeclared { attacker_id, forced, .. }` -> false when *forced. No new ruling needed (R121 decides); add `r121_...` test, add its file to R0121.md proven_in. Rate HARD (engine rules, crates/engine/src).

## VALIDATED in /tmp/scratch (copy of HEAD): fix + tests
engine fix, crates/engine/src/subsystems/craft.rs reveal_trigger `.with_when`:
  GameEvent::AttackDeclared { attacker_id, forced, .. } => !*forced && find_instance(ctx.state, attacker_id).is_some_and(|attacker| attacker.controller == opponent_of(ctx.controller))
tests added to crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c017_true_craft_a_card.rs `mod tests::base` (before r880_the_cost_is_a_number_prompt_from_0_to_4):
  helper attack_trap() recipe (Trap cost 2, hat opponentAttacks, verb summonSheep); helper trap_set_against_a_disruptor():
   scenario p1 hand [ID,"core-008"] mana 10; p2 field Moths core-009 lane1, backrow stinkyscape-024, hand core-053, library [core-001, core-002];
   s.play(ID,{}), s.answer(["2"]), craft_offer=Some(whole_palette()), s.answer([{pick:craft,recipe}]), play crafted card.
  r121_a_crafted_reveal_on_an_attack_does_not_arm_on_a_forced_attack: s.play("core-008",{zone:1}); asserts forced AttackDeclared happened, no TrapFired, trap still backrow(P1,1)  -> FAILS before fix ("a forced attack is not the opponent declaring one"), passes after
  r121_a_crafted_reveal_on_an_attack_still_fires_on_a_declared_one: s.end_turn(); s.attack("core-009","hero"); TrapFired present -> passes.
  Run: cargo test -p jackioh-cards r121_a_crafted  (first debug build ~6 min)
TODO: confirm seed 6091 passes with fix (release scratch), spec check requirements (R0121.md proven_in += c017 file), e2e shard-8 and component investigation.

## e2e (8/8) ROOT CAUSE (reproduced locally with cypress, shard 8 specs): spec 38 `/practice board (phone)`
 Failure: "exceptions in axe-exceptions.ts that no longer fire: expected ['target-size .pile--browsable'] to deeply equal []" (e2e/support/a11y.ts:96).
 Cause: #3366 (307394f04a) added the opening deal (apps/web/src/game/opening.ts; Game.tsx sets data-dealing="true" on [data-testid=game] for ~1.8 s after a mulligan-phase first view).
 `cy.settled()` only drains [data-animating], so spec 38 runs axe while the dealt hand cards still fly over the pile (cards at (11,591) until ~1 s, data-dealing until ~1.7 s):
 axe's target-size does not flag the pile then; after the deal it does (probe via CDP /tmp/dbg/pile.mjs, timeline.mjs). Other shard-8 specs pass (13 passes once target/release/jackioh exists; 99 is skipped).
 FIX (test only): e2e/cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts: before `cy.settled()` in "/practice board" (and hotseat board) wait for `[data-dealing]` to be gone: add `export const DEALING = "[data-dealing]"` next to ANIMATING in e2e/support/testids.ts.
Component job (cancelled): started a full local `cypress run --component` -> /tmp/cy-component.log to time it (CI timeout-minutes 20).
